summary: Send-to-customer email feature fully tested. All 9 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI tests pass: Send to customer button visible on non-provisioned packets, send-email-panel appears with prefilled recipient, email sends successfully with toast notification, last-sent-status displays correctly, 'Invite sent' badge appears on packet card, button hidden on provisioned packets.

backend_send_email_success.details: Returns {success: true, sent_to: email, send_count: N}, updates packet with last_sent_at, last_sent_to, email_sends array

backend_send_email_with_override.details: Uses override email address instead of primary_contact_email

backend_send_email_no_recipient.details: Returns 400 with 'No recipient email' when packet has no primary_contact_email and no override

backend_multiple_sends_append.details: email_sends array grows with each send, send_count reflects total (tested 3 sends)

backend_regression_create_packet.details: Still creates packets with id, token, share_url, status=draft

backend_regression_list_packets.details: Still returns {packets, count} with share_url and counts fields

frontend_send_to_customer_button_visible.details: data-testid='btn-send-to-customer' visible in packet detail dialog for non-provisioned packets

frontend_send_email_panel_appears.details: data-testid='send-email-panel' appears when clicking Send to customer button, shows recipient email input prefilled from packet

frontend_send_email_confirm.details: data-testid='btn-send-email-confirm' sends email, shows success toast 'Sent to {email}', panel closes

frontend_last_sent_status.details: data-testid='last-sent-status' shows 'Last sent to {email} on {timestamp}' after send

frontend_invite_sent_badge.details: 'Invite sent' badge (sky blue with mail icon) appears on packet card in list view after email sent

frontend_send_button_hidden_provisioned.details: Send to customer button NOT present in packet detail dialog for provisioned packets

critical_code_review_comments: send_onboarding_invite_email helper in utils/email.py correctly builds branded HTML email with onboarding link
Backend correctly validates recipient email format and returns 400 if invalid
email_sends array correctly tracks all sends with sent_at, sent_to, sent_by, sent_by_name
Frontend correctly prefills recipient email from packet.organisation.primary_contact_email
Resend integration is live and working - emails actually send to valid addresses
